description.value: Kelowna's major municipal waterpark and fitness centre, owned by the City and operated by the YMCA of Southern Interior BC. Features include wave pool, lazy river, waterslides, FlowRider, diving boards, hot tub, steam room, and a full fitness area with cardio, conditioning, and cycle studio. Drop-in access is available for non-members.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms this is a large municipal waterpark and fitness centre (City of Kelowna, operated by YMCA). Locker rooms and showers are explicitly listed as branch amenities. Drop-in access is available per the 'Drop-in Rates' link. Phone number discrepancy: OSM has +1-250-764-4040 but website shows 250-491-9622. No mention of bike parking or bike-specific amenities anywhere on the page.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Major public recreation facility with drop-in shower access, useful for touring cyclists needing to clean up. Waterpark and fitness centre also serve as a legitimate attraction stop in Kelowna.
enrichment_extras.notes: Photo ID required for entry for ages 19+. Facility requires membership or drop-in payment for access.

Showers (drop-in or fee).detail: Locker rooms and showers listed as open amenities; drop-in rates available for non-members
